from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashPosition(BaseModel):
    """A cash-related financial figure extracted from a specific document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label from the financial statement (e.g. 'Cash and cash equivalents')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash balance as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period for this figure")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the amount and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_positions: list[CashPosition]
